 Blink-182, Pierce the Veil to headline When We Were Young in 2027
 The When We Were Young festival will return to the Las Vegas Festival Grounds in October 2027 after a hiatus this year, organizers announced Tuesday, Nov. 17, 2026. Photo by:
 Gina Joy / Courtesy
 By
 Las Vegas Sun Staff
 ( contact )
 Tuesday, Nov. 17, 2026 | 3:15 p.m.
 Blink-182 and Pierce the Veil will headline the 2027 When We Were Young festival, organizers announced today, bringing the emo and pop-punk event back to Las Vegas after a hiatus this year.
 The fifth edition, presented by 7-Eleven, is scheduled for Oct. 16, 2027, at the Las Vegas Festival Grounds. Organizers plan more than 50 performances across four stages.
 Limp Bizkit, Third Eye Blind, the Used, All Time Low, Simple Plan, 5 Seconds of Summer, Circa Survive, Taking Back Sunday, Sleeping With Sirens, the Psychedelic Furs, Hot Mulligan, New Found Glory and Movements also will perform.
 A presale will begin at 10 a.m. Friday. Fans can sign up now for a presale passcode at whenwewereyoungfestival.com . Guaranteed lowest-price general admission tickets will be available during the first hour of the presale, and a general on-sale will follow at 11 a.m. if any tickets remain.
 Tickets will be available at general admission, GA+ and VIP levels, along with VIP cabana packages. Jampack will offer official festival hotel-and-ticket packages.
 GA+ tickets include a private lounge, air-conditioned restrooms and a dedicated entry lane at the main entrance, among other perks.
 VIP tickets include preferred viewing areas across all stages, shaded seating in VIP lounges, charging stations and a dedicated festival merchandise tent, among other amenities.
 VIP cabanas, open only to people 21 and older, include 10 tickets, the GA+ and VIP amenities, two complimentary select bottles, food vouchers and a private entrance, among other perks. The Jampack packages include discounted rates at select nearby Las Vegas hotels.
 The festival took place every October from 2022 through 2025 at the Las Vegas Festival Grounds. Blink-182 headlined the 2023 and 2025 editions; Panic! at the Disco co-headlined the 2025 edition in a one-off reunion. Pierce the Veil was on the lineups announced for the 2022 and 2024 festivals.
 Organizers said in an Instagram post Feb. 27 that they would skip 2026 to give the festival “the care it deserves.”
